properties.name: veto.memory.store
properties.description: Memory backend: memory, jpa, vector, or pgvector.

properties.name: veto.terminal.enabled
properties.description: Whether the local terminal IPC server is enabled.

properties.description: ZeroMQ bind address for the local terminal IPC server.

properties.description: HTTP request timeout for web_fetch in seconds.

properties.description: Allow web_fetch to contact loopback, link-local, private, or multicast destinations. Keep disabled unless agents must access a trusted intranet.
